E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Harry's new responsibilities pile up. Tzarina struggles to control her department. And all of that seems pretty insignificant when a sudden lightning storm hits. (S3 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homie the Clown: Heavily in debt to Fat Tony, Krusty agrees to set up a clown college, and Homer can't resist the opportunity to start a new career... (S6 Ep15/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bart vs Australia: When Bart's prank phone call damages Australian-American relations, he must travel down under to receive his punishment. (S6 Ep16/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer vs. Patty and Selma: Homer has to ask Patty and Selma for a loan after making a foolish decision about the family's pumpkin investment. (S6 Ep17/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Star Is Burns: At Springfield's new film festival, Barney's haunting movie meditation on his alcoholism is on course to win, until Homer gets involved... (S6 Ep18/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lisa's Wedding: A fortune-teller reveals that Lisa will fall for an upper-crust English gent at a prestigious university. But will he approve of her family? (S6 Ep19/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Chiarella's: Gordon Ramsay visits South Philadelphia, where struggling family-run restaurant Chiarella's is pushing owners Tommy and Dina DeFino's marriage to the brink. (S5 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Antz
E4Plus1.uk.description: (1998) Family animation. An unconventional ant sets out to impress a beautiful stranger who he met on the dancefloor, but accidentally makes a powerful and treacherous enemy instead.

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Kill the Alligator and Run: Homer thinks he only has four years to live. So he takes the family on holiday to Florida, but does something foolish and gets into big trouble... (S11 Ep19/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Last Tap Dance in Springfield: Lisa takes up dancing but discovers that she's not very good at it. Bart and Milhouse duck out of their camping trip and hide out in the mall. (S11 Ep20/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad Marge: Otto's rock 'n' roll marriage to his girlfriend Becky (Parker Posey) is over as soon as it's begun. So Becky moves in with the Simpsons. (S11 Ep21/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Behind the Laughter: A behind-the-scenes look at the Simpson family. How did they win their fame? And how did they cope when the showbiz pressure got too much? (S11 Ep22/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bonfire of the Manatees: Marge meets a handsome marine biologist (guest star Alec Baldwin). Will he woo her? Can Homer win her back? (S17 Ep1/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Home Alone
E4Plus1.uk.description: (1990) Classic family comedy starring Macaulay Culkin. A boy's parents forget to take him on holiday with them. Then two inept burglars turn up. Can our resourceful young hero outwit them?

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Devil Wears Prada
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2006) Comedy-drama starring Anne Hathaway and Meryl Streep. A naive young woman lands a job as assistant to one of New York's most important, but ruthless and cynical, magazine editors.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: What do celebs from Julian Clary to Shaun and Bez and Vicky Pattison think of Rivals, Scream 7, Britain's Got Talent, Canal Boat Diaries and much more? (S8 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers tune in to Gladiators, Is It Cake?, Casualty, The 1% Club, The Yorkshire Farm, This Morning, BBC News on the cost of living, and more. (S23 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the 'Box this time: Race Across the World, The Apprentice, Ripley, MasterChef, Hunted, Celebrity Bridge of Lies, The Assembly and endurance athlete Hardest Geezer. (S23 Ep9) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Farmer Chris brings a beetroot to his first date. Two dog fans commiserate over past loves. And football coach Timi flirts up a storm - but will student Afope flirt back? (S20 Ep3) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Below Deck
E4Plus1.uk.description: The crew embark on a five-day charter with porn stars - and some of them are more excited about it than others. The captain fears his bosun isn't up to scratch. (S12 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Below Deck
E4Plus1.uk.description: The deck team are growing increasingly frustrated with Caio. Rainbeau feels isolated. And new romances are born on the crew's hard-earned night out. (S12 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Below Deck
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fraser questions his long-distance relationship. Captain Kerry is still having doubts about Caio. And Rainbeau tries to build bridges with Barbara and Solène. (S12 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gordon Ramsay revisits three restaurants to find out if they've continued to follow his advice. How have Down City, Classic American and Davide fared in his absence? (S5 Ep16) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gordon Ramsay revisits four restaurants he tried to help: the Spanish Pavillion in New Jersey, and Kingston Café, La Frite and Capri in California. (S5 Ep17) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Butler's Escape: Luke wants to quit magic, but Phil can't accept it. One of Gloria's new pregnancy symptoms is snoring and she's keeping the whole house awake. (S4 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks Omnibus
E4Plus1.uk.description: Vicky's family try to support her. Warren gets some good news, but his happiness is short-lived. Cindy is determined to find out why she was set up. And the villagers rally around Ste.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Yard Sale: Jay and Gloria hold a yard sale for Manny and Luke's school charity fundraiser. Manny finds an old trunk that hides a secret that Gloria wants to keep under wraps. (S4 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds: Santa's Little Helper fathers a huge litter of puppies, so Mr Burns offers them a home. But Burns has always fancied a greyhound-fur tuxedo... (S6 Ep20/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The PTA Disbands: Bart's over the moon when the teachers go on strike, but Lisa starts to go mad. And then the governors draft in the parents to teach... (S26 Ep21/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Girl Who Slept Too Little: Lisa becomes plagued by nightmares when the council move the cemetery next door to the Simpsons' house. (S17 Ep2/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Milhouse of Sand and Fog: Milhouse is annoyed when his parents get back together. Homer catches chicken pox. (S17 Ep3/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Marge's Son Poisoning: Bart gets picked on at school for riding a tandem with Marge. (S17 Ep5/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: See Homer Run: To make amends for dismissing Lisa's Father's Day gift, Homer dons a Safety Salamander suit for a campaign at her school - and ends up running for mayor. (S17 Ep6/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Last of the Red Hat Mamas: Marge joins a women's group after Homer humiliates her at a party and her old friends shun her. But are her new friends all they seem to be? (S17 Ep7/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Home
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2015) Colourful animation. The fate of the world rests with a 12-year-old from Barbados and an alien who's accidentally invited another entire enemy species to a party in his flat.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: La Galleria 33 (Part 1/2): Gordon tries to help La Galleria 33, run by sisters Rita and Lisa, who blame the restaurant's failures on everything from tablecloths to the weather. (S6 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: La Galleria 33 (Part 2/2): The saga of Boston eatery La Galleria 33 comes to a dramatic conclusion as Gordon Ramsay gives restaurant owners and sisters Rita and Lisa an ultimatum. (S6 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
E4Plus1.uk.description: (1992) Family comedy. Macaulay Culkin ends up in a swish New York hotel while his family are in Miami. Nosy-but-kindly concierge Tim Curry keeps an eye on him as the Wet Bandits close in.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Cruising Paradise: Above &...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Below Deck: Brand new series - The Star Princess drops anchor in Belize for a mangrove meander and some snorkelling with sharks and stingrays. (Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Lego Masters Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - What's in Toy Store: It's all to play for as each team chooses an empty toy package and must invent a matching toy with a standout special feature. (S7 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Freddy's Steak House: At Freddy's in Indiana, the stakes are high, the steaks are dry and there's more beef between the staff than there is on the tables. (S10 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: Standout moments from Series 6, when the celebs watched Bridgerton, MILF Manor, Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders, and Donald Trump's victory in the 2024 US presidential election.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Sarah Millican: Late Bloomer
E4Plus1.uk.description: When Sarah Millican was a bairn, she wouldn't say boo to a goose. But now? She's goose-booing all over the shop! Sarah's seventh stand-up special explores how one Sarah became the other.
